entry_points.text: Top-level UV init chooses none/hubbed/hubless by probe. Hubless orders NMI arming, firmware init, table decode, block sizing, user files and reboot choice, aborting on firmware/table failure.
Firmware dir always has arch file plus one hub-mode file by hubless flag, each read single value with one-time sysfs notice. Power-off selects CPU-pinned firmware restart versus direct off.

File ops validate identity each path; open registers with credential-derived privilege; read blocks interruptibly with nonblock/size checks; poll reports readability; privileged ioctls ack or inject requests possibly blocking; release folds counts, unlinks and frees.
Startup pins to boot CPU, caps firmware version with fallback, enables/engages, installs power-off/display handlers, then timed-loops event dispatch until stopped.

exports.text: Boot services provide halt-based idle fallback and non-returning restart that records CMOS intent under lock, installs trampoline paging with full TLB purge, then jumps to low memory with build-dependent transfer.
APM user surface is a misc device plus open/release/read/poll/ioctl/seek table; misc registration failure only logs. Shared firmware entry block links low-level code.

hazards.text: Off-CPU0 or missing descriptor guard faults firmware; mismatched IRQ save/restore corrupts flags; racy identity free leaks or use-after-free; absent presence miscounts blades; error paths must not free static blade0.

Queue overflow drops oldest with one-time diag; display retries once after engage; idle refusal falls back to halt; busy rate-limited while acks outstanding; MP without opt-in, ACPI override and known bad machines refused or degraded with pinned-CPU descriptors.
BIOS magic 0x4101, per-user queue 20, check timeout one tick, bounce three ticks; logging uses short prefix.

Reboot writes 0x00 to CMOS 0x0f via 0x8f. Status reports versions, caps, AC/battery/percent/lifetime; unknowns 0xff, -1, 0xffff, 0x8000 minutes select. Interface caps 1.2 with 1.0 fallback, gates above 1.0.

invariants.text: Possible blades come from socket presence mask folded into min/max, updating bounds only when observed. Socket maps build first-write-wins skipping holes, NUMA from firmware APIC data; range-table absence tolerated only on two newer hubs.

Conversion tables allocate count by width, log failure once, prefill empty marker. Identity tables free only when present with agreeing sizes and fully identity-mapped, clearing caller pointer. Reboot keeps method unless EFI off, then ACPI.

Firmware runs on CPU0 via fast path or sync delegation. One GDT slot gets temporary conservative BIOS descriptor restored after. IRQ state saves with capability-dependent policy and exact restore, plus mitigation bracketing and build-dependent segment handling; status derives from shifted output byte.

Version negotiates via caller value updated from firmware. Event poll clears inputs, marks info invalid on old revisions. Power forwards selectors. Enable/engage cache flags and reject redundant moves. Status splits line/battery/lifetime with broken-firmware and byte-order quirks.

Idle driver pairs empty poll with named firmware state carrying costs and enter hook. Idle avoids firmware when work pending, reports only first failures, tracks slow-clock flag. Errors resolve via keyed table else host/unknown paths; event names cover defined events.
Boot options parse comma tokens with dash/underscore tolerance and negation prefix. DMI handlers set persistent disable/idle/interrupt/power flags with info log. Offset unit marks host-side emission.

locks.text: Spinlock guards user list linkage, queue indices and pending tallies. Mutex serializes management and suspend control. Firmware pinned to CPU0 with IRQ save/restore around transitions.
Registry lock also covers enqueue and completion broadcast; separate platform lock guards reboot-intent register update.

state_machines.text: Hubbed bringup sequences detection, low map, firmware/table decode, translation build, hub descriptions with static blade0 else NUMA-local alloc, per-CPU links, high map of three classes, and service registration; unknown hub or corrupt table aborts, missing translation on newer hubs tolerated.

Suspend/standby bracket firmware move with quiesce/resume, context save/restore, optional timer reprogram and resume broadcast completing waiters. Drain suppresses bounce duplicates, coalesces suspend while outstanding, queues for ack, clears on resume, forwards power-change, ignores time and never refuses critical suspend.

Lifecycle goes quirk eval, BIOS/capability gating requiring 32-bit, no ACPI, MP opt-in and nonzero BIOS, then segment/publication/thread/idle; teardown reverses. MP power-off-only succeeds without full controls. Idle re-evaluates after quiet window, disables on gaps, enables on sleep share, retries bounded then halts.

structs.text: Per-opener state holds validation marker, list link, privilege/mode flags, bounded ring with producer/consumer positions, outstanding versus consumed standby/suspend tallies, wait flag and outcome slot.
BIOS call block holds selector, dual in/out pair, extra register outs and signed status. Helpers are numeric-key/message pair and offset/segment firmware entry.
Quirk table pairs firmware match tuples over system/board/BIOS with handler and label, ending in empty sentinel, evaluated before other checks.

Host-emitted names cover boot, CPU, task/stack, hibernation, entry/TSS, reg-save, TLB, virt, signals, crypto and patching; 32-bit adds reg/segment positions, 64-bit adds control-reg/descriptor with conditional steal-time/paravirt.
